text:
ellie: Heads up — CI on my branch feature/serving-reorg is red after I merged main. 3 failing tests in runtime/kernel_allocator_test. Repro locally after a clean build too. Any quick ideas?

ci-bot: Jenkins #build-8791 failed: https://ci.internal/builds/8791
Failed tests: runtime/kernel_allocator_test::TEST_KV_SHARD_ALLOC (3 failures)
Log excerpt:
```
E runtime/allocator.cc:142] assert(size % 256 == 0) failed
terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'
```
Triggered by commit 9f2b4c3 (merge main into feature/serving-reorg).

ryan: Did you rebase or merge? If merge, there's a chance a duplicate change to allocator alignment landed on main. Try `git bisect` between main@9f2b4c3 and your branch tip. Quick bisect steps:
```
git checkout feature/serving-reorg
git bisect start HEAD 9f2b4c3
# run the test
```
I can run a bisect if you want.

ellie: I merged main (not rebased). Happy for you to run bisect, saves me time. Local nohup run shows same assert. I also tried `make -j8 test/runtime/kernel_allocator_test`.

maria: Two thoughts: 1) We recently bumped jemalloc on main (PR #3210) which changed alignment behavior in allocator wrappers. 2) One of your commits touches include order for allocator.h — that could be sensitive. If bisect points to the jemalloc bump, we should revert or add a compatibility guard.

ryan: Starting bisect now, will post results.

ci-bot: @ryan started bisect job #bisect-224
Progress: 4/12 tested.

ryan: Bisect suggests first bad commit is 9f2b4c3 (the merge) but the root cause looks like commit 8b1a772 on main (jemalloc bump). Confirming with a minimal repro building with jemalloc old vs new.

ashley: Another quick check — can you try running only that test under a sanitized env? e.g.,
```
sanitizer=address LD_PRELOAD=/usr/local/lib/libjemalloc.so ./runtime/kernel_allocator_test
```
Might surface a different stack or alignment point.

ellie: Ran with the older jemalloc binary and tests pass. Ran with the new one and fail. So looks like the jemalloc bump is the trigger.

maria: OK, two choices: cherry-pick a tiny compatibility fix into the allocator wrapper (preferred) or pin jemalloc version in CI for the branch until we fix. I'll open a small PR to detect alignment and adjust allocation.

ellie: Thanks @maria. Can you also trigger a rerun once PR is up? I want to get CI green on this branch.

ryan: CI rerun requested: https://ci.internal/builds/8793 (with jemalloc pinned)
ci-bot: Rerun queued.

ci-bot: Build 8793 finished: PASSED. All tests green :tada:

ellie: Awesome, thanks everyone. Follow-up: I'll rebase onto main after we merge maria's fix so the branch is clean.
